caption: The drawing is composed in a primarily red hue on a beige background and features a group of human figures, both male and female, in classical attire gathered outdoors among trees and plants. In the lower central section, a woman kneels before a smoking altar, flanked by large urns and amphorae on the ground. Another woman stands nearby holding a large vessel, while two more women with veiled headdresses stand to the left and right, one holding a plate and the other with her hands at her side. A man in formal dress stands among them, holding a scroll or document. In the top portion of the drawing, cherubic winged figures and a reclining figure appear among clouds, with birds and stylized clouds filling the sky. In the background to the right, there is a conical tent or structure, and a large, leafy tree dominates the right side of the composition. The entire scene is finely detailed with intricate line work and shading.
title: Printed Textile - Historical
